known_outcome: Determination (19 June 2023, s 188): the authority was correct on or about 24 January 2022 to propose a notice to fix under section 164 for a change of use under section 115 (p.37 §8.1). Reasoning: the classified use was housing (multi-unit dwelling) with a use-group change from SA to SR (p.34-36); the new use has additional or more onerous requirements, with clauses G3 and H1.3.4(c) as examples (p.35-36 §6). Fire and escape requirements are part of the statutory test and the parties' submissions, not the decision's main ground.
review_focus: Whether the answer separates the use-group classification from the fire-safety submission.
Whether it names the qualified set of requirements (means of escape, fire-rating) and does not treat fire as the main ground.
Whether it asks for the occupancy, household-unit and fire-safety records.
Whether it does not treat the eight-fire statistic as evidence of a building deficiency.
Whether it avoids stating that the building is compliant or safe.
